ArchitectureBoundaryTests.Winnow_Core_re.reason: Electron uses the independent backend. Its unchanged domain assembly remains BCL-only; the original compiled-assembly check passes against a fresh build.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.Winnow_Recomme.reason: Scoring remains in the shared backend module, whose only Winnow reference is Core. The original compiled reference guard still exercises the active implementation.

tests.case: embedded sign-in hosts compile against frontend contracts without backend repository or transport implementations

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.The_embedded_s.reason: Both Electron sign-in hosts are bundled independently and their complete dependency graphs exclude backend implementations, SQLite and the injected API transport implementation. They consume frontend types and callbacks; native browser and security helpers replace Avalonia browser hosting.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.An_ingest_modu.reason: The backend still composes the same three read-only ingest assemblies. The original compiled-type guard checks that none references an identity-writing repository.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.Every_ingest_m.reason: The Steam, Epic and GOG sources remain registered in the backend and emit CandidateOwnership. The original assembly metadata assertion passes unchanged.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.No_ingest_modu.reason: All launcher readers remain backend-owned. The original whole-source write guard passes; its reviewed GOG exception copies the database and WAL to a private temporary directory and cleans up only that private copy.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.Steam_ingest_p.reason: Steam ingest still references ValveKeyValue and its KeyValues1 adapter uses the library parser. The original compiled assembly-reference check passes.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.No_module_decl.reason: Parsing remains in the shared backend; Electron calls snapshots and commands. The original scan of compiled Winnow assemblies still excludes hand-written VDF, ACF and KeyValues parsers.

tests.case: views and their shared types cannot import native or backend implementations

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.No_view_or_vie.reason: An AST scan includes imports, exports, type signatures, dynamic literal imports, require calls and escaped module names across every renderer/shared source. Adversarial fixtures verify rejection while comments and ordinary documentation strings are ignored.

tests.case: the compiled renderer and drawing worker dependency graphs stay in presentation and shared contracts
views and their shared types cannot import native or backend implementations

ArchitectureBoundaryTests.No_view_model_.reason: The actual renderer and worker are bundled in memory and their transitive dependency graphs exclude backend/native implementations. The accompanying AST scan includes erased TypeScript imports and signature types, so removing types during compilation cannot hide a forbidden dependency.
